Super Rare.desc: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Relinquished". You must also Tribute a monster from your hand or field whose Level is 1 or more.

Super Rare.name: Dark Magician Girl

Super Rare.desc: If "Harpie Lady" is on the field: Special Summon 1 "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" from your hand or Deck.

Super Rare.name: Gearfried the Iron Knight
Super Rare.desc: If either player equips an Equip Card(s) to this card: Destroy that Equip Card(s).

Super Rare.name: Gravekeeper's Priestess

Super Rare.name: Gravekeeper's Stele
Super Rare.desc: Target 2 "Gravekeeper's" monsters in your GY; add those targets to your hand. This effect cannot be negated by the effect of "Necrovalley".

Super Rare.name: Harpie Lady 1

(This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)
All WIND monsters gain 300 ATK.

Super Rare.name: Lord of D.

Super Rare.name: The Flute of Summoning Dragon
Super Rare.desc: Special Summon up to 2 Dragon monsters from your hand. "Lord of D." must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

Super Rare.name: Time Wizard

If you call it wrong, destroy as many monsters you control as possible, and if you do, take damage equal to half the total ATK those destroyed monsters had while face-up on the field.

Super Rare.name: Toon Table of Contents

Super Rare.name: Wonder Wand

Ultra Rare.desc: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

Ultra Rare.name: Dark Magician
Ultra Rare.desc: ''The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.''

Ultra Rare.name: Gravekeeper's Oracle
Ultra Rare.desc:
You can Tribute 3 monsters or 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster to Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card. When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can activate any of these effects, and resolve in sequence, up to the number of "Gravekeeper's" monsters Tributed for its Summon;
● This card gains ATK equal to the combined Levels that all monsters Tributed for its Tribute Summon had on the field x 100.
● Destroy all Set monsters your opponent controls.
● All monsters your opponent currently controls lose 2000 ATK/DEF.

Ultra Rare.name: Harpie Lady Sisters
Ultra Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned with "Elegant Egotist".

Ultra Rare.name: Red-Eyes Black Dragon
Ultra Rare.desc: ''A ferocious dragon with a deadly attack.''

Ultra Rare.name: Relinquished
Ultra Rare.desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Black Illusion Ritual". Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1). This card's ATK/DEF become equal to that equipped monster's. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster instead. While equipped with that monster, any battle damage you take from battles involving this card inflicts equal effect damage to your opponent.
